title: DATESWTD over a calendar, with the date filtered, runs from the start of the week to that date
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "first", MINX ( DATESWTD ( Weekly ), 'Date'[Date] ), "last", MAXX ( DATESWTD ( Weekly ), 'Date'[Date] ), "days", COUNTROWS ( DATESWTD ( Weekly ) ) ), 'Date'[Date] = DATE ( 2008, 8, 14 ) )

source.quote: If the filter context filters the column tagged as Day, the result ends with the last visible day.
source.supports: the rule; the page's example, CALCULATETABLE ( DATESWTD ( 'Weekly 445' ), 'Date'[Date] = DATE ( 2008, 8, 14 ) ), lists August 10 to 14

derivation: Date is tagged Date in Weekly; the last visible date is Thursday 2008-08-14; its week starts on Sunday August 10: August 10 to 14, 5 days.
